modelingNotes.sourcePriority: Preserve the final supplied avatar.png when an earlier prompt or earlier artwork differs.
modelingNotes.palette: Hex colors are approximate local material colors chosen from the visible illustration; shading in the raster is not a material measurement.
modelingNotes.geometry: Create complete volumetric bodies and clothing, including rear surfaces. These PNGs show only a front or three-quarter front; unobserved rear shapes are new modeling work rather than recovered source geometry.
modelingNotes.identity: Dataset keys are display associations only. Do not identify a depicted face as an actual survey respondent or infer appearance from respondent race, nationality, religion, politics, or other questionnaire answers.
modelingNotes.branding: The supplied ISSP2016 illustrations visibly include esports team and sponsor graphics. Do not describe those two source illustrations as generic unbranded fictional faces.
